dataFlow.reason: Presentational surface with an optional dialog quick look; no route data.

gaps: Phase 1 still-port: the quick look is a normal Dialog (overlay + panel). The shared-layout morph — layoutId across card/panel for the surface, media, title, description, byline and action, the `returning` landing rects, and the `data-returning` state — is Phase 2 and is this port's designated layoutId spike.

React forceMounts Dialog.Portal/Overlay/Content so the closing surface stays mounted while it travels back to the card. With no morph in Phase 1, the portal renders only while `open` (the reduced-motion path behaves the same), so no forceMount is needed yet. Phase 2 reintroduces it for the return trip.
`whileHover={{ y: -2 }}` (card lift) and the media zoom are Phase 2; Phase 1 keeps the `data-hover` attribute (pointer enter/leave) so the CSS border/shadow lift still works.
ResizeObserver geometry (pixel radii + description measure) is a morph-only concern and is omitted in Phase 1.
